verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only describes GitHub's CI/CD and Actions in general terms ("ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD," automating workflows in the repository). Nothing in it documents deployment environments, required reviewers or approval gates before a release, or any way to link incidents to specific deployments. The Atlassian integration mentions syncing development data with Jira, but it does not describe incident-to-deployment mapping, so the axis applies and remains unevidenced.
